yt_title: What to Do in the First 15 Minutes After a Nuclear Warning #shorts
hook: Your phone screams: nuclear attack warning. Official guidance for the first 15 minutes: get inside, go deep, seal up, stay 24 hours, stay tuned.
save_line: Save this and send it to your family.
sources: CDC, Get inside, stay inside, stay tuned: https://www.cdc.gov/radiation-emergencies/safety/index.html
note: Public guidance, not a forecast. Follow your local officials.
